A candidate registered for the MPhil degree may apply for upgrading to PhD/DPhil, after completion of not less than twelve

duration of further study, if any, which shall be required to pursue for the PhD/DPhil shall be prescribed by Senate.

HPHS 201 Public Policy and Human Rights
This module focuses on the study of public policy and Human rights. This module gives students a critical appreciation of
the concepts, theories, principles, processes and practical issues in public policy-making and Human rights. Public Policy

6.7.1 Resident students' parent may visit them in their rooms from 1000 to 2230

Monday to Friday
1200 to 2230 hours

1200 to 0000 hours
Sunday
1030 to 2230 hours
6.7.3 Outside the prescribed visiting hours, all parts to the halls except the Common Rooms and
entrance foyers are out of bounds to members of the opposite sex.
6.7.4 Special arrangements may be made by application to the Warden of the
Hall concerned.
6.7.5 These provisions apply to all students - undergraduate and Post-Graduate.

This space is primarily designed for postgraduate students who wish to research independently.

2.4 24-Hour Study Centres
These are dedicated spaces opened 24 hours a day and designed to facilitate a focused, quiet, and
comfortable study experience. The 24-Hour Study Centres are fitted with plug-top desktops for
plugging in laptops and have WIFI hotspots.

evidence.heading: Section: FACULTY OF ENGINEERING AND GEOSCIENCES > 3 Department of Crop Production and Horticulture
evidence.text:
[MSU Humanities Yearbook, p. 79]
Technology Development.
In 2021, the University was licenced for MSU Radio and the station was allocated two frequencies, one in Zvishavane at
90.3 FM and another in Gweru at 101.7 FM. MSU Radio manned shifts started on February 18, 2023. At the moment the
station is on air every day of the week from 0600hrs to 2100hrs broadcasting programmes such as; Breakfast Show, Mid-
Morning Show, Lunchtime Listening, Drive Time Show and The After Drive. The year 2024 saw the launch of the Our
Destiny (OD) Stores. Established as a retail shop, OD Stores pursue the Education 5.0 blueprint's agenda to locally
produce and distribute goods & services for the nation.
